interactions.note: The engine only charges the crawl cost when mode is 'walk' or 'crawl', so a prone creature with a Climb Speed moves at normal cost. This is red.
The extra costs stack: crawling 5 ft through Difficult Terrain costs 15 ft. This is green.
stand_up only checks the budget when it is the creature's turn. Off-turn in combat it ends Prone for free. This is red.
The cost is half the Speed, not half the movement left after a Dash. This is green.
An odd modified Speed (25) costs 12 to stand. This depends on the current-Speed reading.

interactions.with: stage A gap (too little movement left)
interactions.note: The engine refuses when movement left is less than the cost. Proposed ruling below.
Every Speed-0 source blocks standing up, including a grapple gained mid-turn with movement left. This is green.
Disadvantage and Advantage cancel to a normal roll. This is green.
Prone Disadvantage applies to spell attack rolls too. This is green.

interactions.with: ranged attack with a hostile within 5 ft
interactions.note: Prone Advantage cancels the ranged-in-melee Disadvantage. This is green.
The engine measures between point positions and has no creature footprint, so a Large attacker standing adjacent can count as beyond 5 ft. Not testable.
An attack from 10 ft with reach gets Disadvantage. This is green.

abuse.reason: Off-turn, stand ends Prone for free. Red.
Moving 20 ft while prone costs 40 and is refused cleanly.

abuse.reason: A climb while prone is accepted at normal cost. Red.

abuse.reason: The grapple is applied mid-turn with 30 ft left, and stand is refused.

abuse.case: Paying half your movement after a Dash instead of half your Speed (new)
abuse.reason: The cost stays 15 after a Dash.
Each stand costs 15, and the third is refused.

abuse.reason: The refusal cites no page. Red.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: GLOSS.prone ambiguity 1: 'half your Speed (round down)' — current Speed after modifiers, or base Speed?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Use the creature's current Speed after all modifiers, halved and rounded down (Speed 25 costs 12; Speed 5 costs 2).

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: GLOSS.prone gap: righting yourself with less movement left than half your Speed.
rulings_proposed.ruling: Refuse it cleanly. Righting yourself needs at least the full cost in remaining movement, and no partial cost carries over.

output.summary: I added 41 GLOSS.prone tests to tests/srd/test_glossary.py and wrote one journey (tests/srd/journeys/test_prone_journey.py). Every clause has positive and negative tests, the threshold clauses have boundary tests, and abuse cases are covered too. The tests cover: crawling at double cost, which stacks with Difficult Terrain; the stand-up cost of half the Speed, including round-down, the exact-cost and short-movement boundaries, and the cost after a Dash; the Speed-0 refusal from grappled, restrained and a penalty (also when grappled mid-turn); the prone attacker's Disadvantage on melee, ranged and spell attacks; and the Advantage within 5 ft (diagonal included) versus Disadvantage beyond it (a 10-ft reach attack included), with cancellation against other sources. Three tests are red: (1) a prone creature can move with its Climb Speed at normal cost instead of crawling; (2) the stand command on another creature's turn ends Prone without spending movement; (3) standing up when not Prone is refused without citing a page. I strengthened test_cond02 per stage B with checks for #4, #1 and a clean Speed-0 refusal, and added three cheats to the abuse catalogue. Large-creature adjacency (ambiguity 3) needs creature footprints, which the engine doesn't have. Results: 101 passed, 34 xfailed (3 of them new); ruff check and format are clean.
